description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - Registered Stock and Securities Ordinance (Chapter 420)
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the President under the Registered Stock and Securities Ordinance, establishing legal requirements for disclosure of public debt information. It creates a regulatory framework for information sharing between government entities and appointed advisors, specifying confidentiality requirements and legal procedures. This falls under Legal/Regulatory classification as it establishes statutory instruments and regulatory compliance requirements rather than focusing on government personnel changes or organizational structure.
